user_query: Compare how LINE(2nd) and node2vec each exploit graph structure: which one is evaluated on word analogy using Wikipedia word networks, and which one reuses samples across source nodes to improve sampling efficiency?
llm_response: LINE(2nd) is the method evaluated on word analogy using Wikipedia word networks. node2vec is the method that reuses samples across source nodes to improve sampling efficiency.
llm_confidence_reasoning: This matches the standard descriptions of the two methods in the literature: LINE(2nd) is tested on word analogy tasks with Wikipedia word networks, while node2vec uses biased random walks that can be reused across source nodes for more efficient sampling.
